## About

Two passages of the ambient score sit end to end on Audio 1: the first bed plays the opening of
the track, the second starts 40 s into it. A Constant Power crossfade 48 frames long is centred
on the change at 10 s, so neither bed dips in loudness while they overlap. The picture is the misty
forest on Video 1 (its own sound left out) with the session's chapter title arriving with the new bed.
